home.title: Amplify your intelligence.
home.description: CoBrain is a smart knowledge management app that helps you capture, organize, and reuse everything you care about — links, tweets, code, and thoughts — all structured into brains, slices, and memos you can access anytime.

features.description: Store anything, structure it with slices and memos, and keep your knowledge private or share it effortlessly.

list.name: Store Anything
list.description: Save text notes, important links, tweets, documents, code snippets, and todo lists in one place.

list.name: Slices & Memos
list.description: Divide your brain into slices (categories) and use memos to neatly store and manage related information.

list.name: Share or Stay Private
list.description: Keep your brain private or share specific slices with anyone using a simple link.

list.name: Edit Anytime
list.description: Update, delete, or add new brains to a slice whenever your knowledge evolves.

faq.title: Frequent Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about CoBrain. Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out to us.

items.question: What is CoBrain?
items.answer: CoBrain is a personal knowledge management app designed to act as your second brain.

items.question: What can I store?
items.answer: Text, links, tweets, documents, videos, code snippets, and todo lists.

items.question: Can I share my brain?
items.answer: Yes, you can share individual slices or keep everything private.

footer.description: CoBrain is a smart knowledge management app that helps you capture, organize, and reuse everything you care about.
